channel.title: ASF Jira
channel.description: This file is an XML representation of an issue

item.title: [IGNITE-6214] Binary metadata update may hang
item.description:
Sometimes client may hang when performing concurrent SQL updates.

Reproducing code is in the attachment.

The reason is that insert triggers metadata update, which may leave some of the nodes infinitely waiting when performed concurrently.

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.
